items.description: Stainless Steel Mirror Finish Cabin is a design created to reflect your Building Richness.

This marvelleous model comes with a complete Mirror Finish Car Enclosure with a False Ceiling fitted with Blower for a cooling effect inside the Car. The Mirror Finish Cabin comes with Fully Automatic Doors available in both Centre Opening or Telescopic doors.

Bring unmatched sophistication to your building with our Stainless Steel Mirror Finish Cabin, designed to reflect modern luxury and elevate every ride. Crafted with high-grade mirror-finish stainless steel, this cabin exudes brilliance, space, and a sleek contemporary feel—ideal for premium residential, commercial, and hospitality spaces. Complete with fully automatic doors (centre opening or telescopic), designer ceilings, ambient lighting, and digital indicators, this model combines flawless aesthetics with next-level safety and technology. If you're looking to make a lasting impression while ensuring passenger comfort and reliability, this is your ultimate choice.

contentSection.description: Elevate your interiors with the Stainless Steel Mirror Finish Cabin, a statement of luxury and sophistication. This model features a full mirror-finish stainless steel car enclosure, offering a sleek, reflective surface that adds visual space and elegance to any residential or commercial building.

items3.text: Full mirror-finish stainless steel car enclosure for luxury
Sleek, reflective surface adds visual space and elegance

Fully automatic centre opening or telescopic doors

contentSection.description2: The Mirror Finish Cabin is not only visually striking but also technologically advanced. It includes plasma display indicators inside the car, LED digital indicators on each floor, and SS90 square buttons for a modern user interface. All operating panels and faceplates are crafted in stainless steel with mirror finish for a consistent and upscale look

items4.text: Plasma and LED indicators for clear navigation
SS90 square buttons for a modern interface
Mirror-finish panels and faceplates for a premium look
Electronic door safety sensors for passenger protection
Optional upgrades: LED effects, handrails, and sound systems
